newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican soft drinks seen up on sugar price-analyst.
newsitem.headline: Mexican soft drinks seen up on sugar price-analyst.

text.p: Mexican soft drink bottlers will likely raise their prices shortly in order to offset the 14.1 percent rise in the reference price of sugar that took place on January 15, Valores Finamex analyst Francisco Rivero said in a report released on Thursday.
"We expect the soft-drink price hikes to go into effect sometime in March, in time to catch the summmer pick-up in sales," he said in the report.
Sugar is the most important raw material used in making soft-drinks in Mexico, accounting for around a third of produciton costs, followed by concentrate, which accounts for about 30 percent.
